turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My phone finally died, and I'm choosing between a few replacements.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me walk you through all the options, then you can tell me what you think.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first one is the latest flagship with an amazing camera, but it costs over a thousand dollars.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's last year's model of the same phone, almost as good and a few hundred cheaper.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option three is a mid range phone with a huge battery that lasts two full days.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is a small compact phone that fits easily in my pocket.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's all I've got. Which would you choose?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Last year's flagship is usually the best value, you get nearly the same camera for much less. The new flagship only makes sense if photos are really important to you. The mid range phone is great if battery life is your biggest worry.
